title: Canonical bootstrap/benchmarks и один CP6 build window
goal: Сохранить ранний JAX setup, рабочие benchmark commands и настоящие apps при retirement точных старых адресов.
work_type: C126-G01 lifecycle; G02 supported bootstrap qualification; G03 docs/build qualification
preservation: Common early JAX defaults/setdefault и explicit overrides.
Canonical bootstrap4profiles и root benchmark suite IDs/CLI.
Independent research tools, LK16 shell/dashboard/client и LK23 styleguide не удаляются.
technical_solution: Finite census точных3benchmark addresses, migrate actual jobs/imports to root benchmarks and remove only after supported exit. Existing advanced census mechanism preferred lexical-only scan. Preserve independent jax/lex/data tools.

Common jax_env now package, not old jax_env.py. Keep apply_jax_env_defaults before actual heavy imports. Bootstrap tests record CommandSpec/run_command, не запускать real system bootstrap. Late demo reference inspect/reproduce in supported selected smoke; do not reconstruct removed domain.state to satisfy stale path blindly.
Root CP6 orchestration reuses existing workspace build/docs/Q2 results for all four lane packets. Build artifact evidence passes CYC-05 bridge owner; no separate readiness issuer here.
coordination: LANE-12 производит actual build/distribution/census evidence с artifact binding. CYC-05 владеет positive build/deployment→N6 readiness bridge в existing confidence_ledger и runtime currentness; здесь не создавать второй issuer/registry. CP6 — одно общее окно Q2/package qualification, не build на каждый alias. CLI-01 owns generated client family; reuse its Node22 results, no parallel install/build.
compatibility: Retired wrappers не восстановить ради obsolete selector. External setup/URL obligations receive explicit decision; no automatic sunset. Canonical suite output remains stable; actual apps retain separate roles.
design_alignment: [North Star §2](../05_Основания/Архитектура/policy-design-causal-operating-system-north-star.md#2-everything-reduces-to-data--but-the-causal-structure-is-not-data) и [синтез §4](../05_Основания/Исследование/design_direction.md): общий действующий owner сохраняется, удаление исторического адреса не заменяет способность; новые compatible resources подключаются через существующий механизм.
open_decisions: DEC-HYG-04-01: benchmark3aliases finite migration/exit table; DEC-HYG-04-02: exact external setup/URL obligations and late-demo consumer scope. Each has source evidence, selected action, acceptance; not all delayed by one unknown external caller.
acceptance: Native recording/import-order, full links and actual build separately. No installer execution for test. Metadata suite listing не scientific benchmark validation.

requirements.text: Три benchmark aliases должны получить finite caller/config/job/package migration и отдельный retirement/temporary support outcome, сохраняя canonical algorithms и CLI contract.
Canonical bootstrap и JAX preparation должны сохранять profile commands и применять defaults до numerical imports, не перезаписывая explicit environment.
Удалённые install.sh/jax_bootstrap/frontend redirect должны оставаться retired при проверенной навигации/lifecycle obligations; дата сама по себе не evidence миграции всех пользователей.
Shared CP6 build/distribution qualification должна сохранять actual apps/packages/research tools и declared roles; early import guard не выдаётся за full demo/production UI proof.
